tests_executed_by_reviewer.scope: final integrated suite including both review regressions

behavioral_strengths: partial core and generated write recovery
old completed plan and batch replay protection
external edits and frozen input conflicts
invalid IDs/type/status/orphan links and exact original references
read-status sidecar provenance without rewriting original events

findings.original_issue: Alternate registry paths could pass proposed-state preflight using core data_override, then fail lineage after ingest had already committed core changes.
findings.reproduction: Manifest and claim ref pointed to archive/claims.json with proposed claim hash; prepare succeeded, apply committed data/claims.json and then failed REF_HASH, with no pending core transaction.
findings.resolution: Runner now requires sources/claims registries to match data/sources.json and data/claims.json before prepare and before apply. Generic read-only lineage supports caller-selected registries separately.

findings.original_issue: Runner accepted CRLF/LF-normalized frozen batch identity while the core recovery journal required exact bytes, so line-ending changes passed plan validation but blocked partial-transaction recovery as a different batch.
findings.reproduction: Interrupted after data/claims.json write; converted frozen batch LF to CRLF; _load_plan accepted while apply raised Another batch has an incomplete transaction.
findings.resolution: Frozen batch uses raw-byte checksum; Git -text preserves it; a line-ending change is rejected before resume with exact LF-byte restoration guidance. Other referenced inputs retain their declared CRLF normalization.

boundary: Local review under original plugin instructions; publication is verified separately. Local reproduction logs and private absolute paths are not published.
